title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_hbr_guide_to_buying_a_small_business_by_richard_s_ruback_royce_yudkoff_0gmgu (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_hbr_guide_to_buying_a_small_business_by_richard_s_ruback_royce_yudkoff_0gmgu' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run.
